reason: The mapping to Articles 9, 15, and 17 of the EU AI Act provides a defensible and sufficiently complete regulatory basis for the control objective. Article 9 establishes the general obligation for risk management, which includes access control. Article 15 mandates the implementation of technical and organizational measures, which encompasses SSO/MFA and least privilege. Article 17 requires regular reviews of the risk management system, which supports access reviews.
applicability_note: The control is applicable to all systems as the EU AI Act imposes obligations on providers of AI systems, which includes the underlying IT infrastructure that supports the AI system.
challenge_comment: The mapping is adequate as the cited provisions collectively support the implementation of SSO/MFA, least privilege, and access reviews as necessary technical and organizational measures for risk management.
